errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states that the line for "ПИБ" (the gray line) declines to 7%. The line starts at approximately 7.5% in 2007, rises to a peak of about 10% in 2009, and only then does it decline to its lowest point of approximately 7% in 2013. The description omits the initial rise entirely.

The description for the "ОББ вкл. СИБ" line (pink) states that its peak of 16-17% occurs around 2011-2012. However, the chart shows the peak occurs in 2010 at approximately 16.5%, and by 2011 the value is already declining.
